subject: general
question:
Sonu starts from point A and drives 61 km towards west. He then takes a left turn, drives 67 km, turns left and drives 67 km. He then takes a left turn and drives 80 km. He takes a final left turn, drives 6 km and stops at point P. How far (shortest distance) and towards which direction should he drive in order to reach point A again?

(Note: All turns are 90^circ turns only unless specified.)
solution:
**Given Movement:**

61 km towards West

Left turn → 67 km

Left turn → 67 km

Left turn → 80 km

Final left turn → 6 km

**Step-by-step Direction Movement:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a8f688483953793baa64a6209533896da04d875b47a5a8fc1c33ffa3928b4018.png] 

To reach Point A again, he must travel **13 km towards South**.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3"**.
